name: CR, DX and MG — one stack for each series
notes: The default `singleImageModality` rule gives each CR, DX or MG image its
own display set. This rule puts the single-frame images of one series into
one stack, in the order ImageLaterality, ViewPosition, InstanceNumber.
The limit `singleImageSeriesMaxImages` (default 9) applies to CR and DX: a
larger series keeps one display set for each image. The limit does not
apply to MG. Change the limit with a context entry, for example
Do not use this rule when a hanging protocol needs one display set for
Priority -1: the rule runs before every default rule.

singleImageSeriesStack.description: CR / DX / MG single images: one stack for each series. CR and DX only up to singleImageSeriesMaxImages images.
